findings.issue: Removing more than the available quantity silently produces negative stock instead of raising ValueError.
findings.fix: Before decrementing, compare qty with item.qty and raise ValueError when qty exceeds stock.
findings.evidence: stock.py:22-24 only decrements; verification with stock 2 then remove 3 printed remaining_qty -1.

findings.issue: The threshold boundary is excluded: quantity equal to threshold is not returned.
findings.fix: Change the predicate from qty < threshold to qty <= threshold.
findings.evidence: stock.py:29-30 uses <; verification for quantity 2 at threshold 2 returned []

findings.issue: CSV price_dollars is parsed as an integer without conversion to cents; decimal dollar amounts are rejected and integer dollars are returned as cents.
findings.fix: Parse dollars precisely and convert to integer cents before returning/passing to Ledger.
findings.evidence: report.py:10-12 returns int(price); 1.50 raises ValueError and 3 returns price 3 rather than 300 cents.
